Terms of use for the ribo.zone free layouts, copied word for word from
https://ribo.zone/free/layouts/ (the "Terms of Use" section) on 2026-09-23.
The raw page is saved beside this file as layouts-page.html.

Terms of Use
You may:
- Change colors, fonts, margins, etc (please do! change it all and make it yours!)
- Move the credit from its default location
- Remove the credit entirely (I think it's worthwhile to cite your sources, but I won't come nag you about it)
- Let me know if something is broken
- Break it yourself
You may not:
- Redistribute these for commercial purposes
- Expect 24/7 tech support

The same page says of the layout gathered here:
"Layout #3: Cyanobacteria / Release date: March 9, 2024 / Inspiration: any
of the top sites on neocities or nekoweb, MagicPattern". The zip's
cyanobacteria.css begins "/* CYANOBACTERIA.CSS v1.1 */ /* HTML/CSS layout
template from https://ribo.zone/free/layouts/ */ /* last updated: june 28,
2026 */", and its template.html carries the credit "layout by ribo.zone"
linking to https://ribo.zone/free/layouts/.
